'''896 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was part of a [[Time/Legends|time]] period known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. In this era, parts of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were opened to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and previously unexplored regions of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] were settled. 896 is the birth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], future [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Proem==
The conflict known as the [[New Sith Wars]]&mdash;which saw a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of fighting between two major [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] factions, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;finally ended in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was in ruins and was reorganized by the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], announced by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]].<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The winning faction of the previous long war, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was codified as a branch of the Republic's [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==The galaxy in 896 BBY==
The era of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] began with the Ruusan Reformation more than one hundred years before the year 896 BBY.<ref name="tcswe-era">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> During these years, the Republic opened the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and unexplored then [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] parts of space were charted by scouts and chartographers. The latter areas later became part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="atlas" />

[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], a Force-sensitive member of a [[Yoda's species/Legends|green-skinned]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was born in the first quarter of the year.<ref name="yodabirth">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' states that Yoda was born in 896 BBY, which year spans approximately 861:3&ndash;860:3 BrS in the year-notation system of the [[Great ReSynchronization]]. ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that by the time he met Luke Skywalker in ''The Empire Strikes Back'', Yoda was already 900 years old. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' marks the beginning of the film at 38:6:6, which puts Yoda's birthdate approximately to 862:6&ndash;861:6 BrS. Sectioning these two timespans narrows Yoda's possible birth date to 861:3&ndash;861:6 BrS, which is the approximately the first quarter of 896 BBY.</ref>

==Impact==
After 896 BBY, the expansion of the Galactic Republic continued during the Great Peace of the Republic, which lasted nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|nine hundred more years]]. In the following years, [[Galactic economy|economic forces]] acquired more and more power in the Republic, as companies established the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] from [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] brought in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]].<ref name="nec" />

[[796 BBY/Legends|At one hundred years of age]], Yoda became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In the following centuries, he [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] countless [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] until they reached [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighthood]]. His many years of contribution to the Order gained him a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Eventually, he ascended to become [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order.<ref name="negtc">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> For centuries, he served as the leader of all Jedi, thus turning him into the "face" of the Council and the embodiment of the Order.<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When nine hundred years old you reach, look as good you will not.|Yoda, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
In [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], Yoda implied to his apprentice, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], that he was nine hundred years old.<ref name="rotj" /> The movie was set [[4 ABY/Legends|four years after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], featured in the first ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. In [[1998]], [[LucasArts]] released ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'', an interactive database on CD-ROM, which was the first to state that Yoda was born in 896 BBY.<ref name="btm" />
